name: 🦃 Turkey & Black Bean Cottage Cheese Bake
tagline: A layered Tex-Mex tortilla bake where cottage cheese melts in for protein and creaminess.

items.name: Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9×13 dish.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium-high, 3 minutes. Add the turkey, press flat and let it brown before breaking it up.
Stir in the taco seasoning, water, beans, corn and half the salsa. Simmer 3 minutes.
In a bowl mix the cottage cheese, the rest of the salsa and 1 cup of the cheese.
Layer: 4 tortillas (tear to fit), half the meat, all the cottage cheese mix, 4 more tortillas, the rest of the meat.
Top with the last cup of cheese. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover 10 more until bubbly.
Rest 5 minutes before cutting so the squares hold. Sour cream on top.

kid_jobs.job: Stir the cottage cheese, salsa and cheese together
Tear tortillas and build the layers
Set the table and put out sour cream and salsa

chef_tip: Season the cottage cheese layer with salsa and cheese: plain cottage cheese tastes flat, but mixed this way it bakes into a creamy, cheesy middle nobody picks out.
make_ahead: Assemble up to a day ahead, cover and fridge; add 10 minutes covered.
leftovers: Squares reheat great for lunch (microwave 90 seconds or 350°F for 15).
swaps: Pepper jack on top for heat
serve_with: Shredded lettuce with lime, or Alexia street corn
